_what: Every room's tags, which group its channel on the chat page (chat.html). tools/make-chat.py reads this and writes the groups onto the page; cb.js draws them. A room is under every tag it has, in the street's walking order; a tag's group is drawn in the order the tags are listed here.
_who: Ryan's ask, 2026-10-24: give rooms tags and group the chat by them. His come first, Music to Make/build, in his order and his words; the rest were added the same day so that every room has a tag that is true of it, and they are his to change.
_rules: A tag is a claim about a room, so it must be true of it: music and videos mean something to press and play there, and make-chat.py holds those two to the Now Playing bill both ways. Every room on the street's list has at least one tag, Community's included (Ryan, the same morning: they are in Community and under their tags as well), except World, which is the whole street's channel and first in Community, and the Staff rooms (MOD_ROOMS), which the chat lists only for a pass that can go in. A new room needs its tags before make-chat.py will run. Never a room that keeps to itself (it is not on the street's list). Keys are filenames, index.html for the street.
